LightningComponentBundle.description: Radial hierarchical visualization using concentric rings (d3.partition + d3.arc). Supports flat auto-nesting, two-level server hierarchy, and pre-built hierarchy data.

property.name: soqlQuery
property.label: SOQL Query
property.description: SOQL query to fetch data for the sunburst
property.placeholder: SELECT StageName, Type, Amount FROM Opportunity WHERE Amount > 0

property.name: groupByField
property.label: Group By Field
property.description: API name of the field for the inner ring (primary hierarchy level)

property.name: secondaryGroupByField
property.label: Secondary Group Field
property.description: Optional second field for an outer ring (creates a third level)

property.name: valueField
property.label: Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field to aggregate (not needed for Count)

property.name: operation
property.label: Aggregation
property.description: How to aggregate values within each group

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object API name for navigation on click

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to use for filtering when navigating (defaults to groupByField)

property.name: filterClause
property.label: Filter Clause
property.description: Optional SOQL WHERE clause for server-side aggregation (without WHERE keyword)

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum records to process. Leave empty for default.

property.name: fetchMode
property.label: Data Source
property.description: How to fetch data: auto (existing priority order), apex (Apex-backed SOQL), or graphql (UI API GraphQL)
